intent.title: Isolate each Build in its own Candidate worktree and harness home

evidence.locator: Workspace admission creates isolated worktree, owner record, deps copy and frozen Approved copy; tests cover spaced roots and volatile-state exclusion.
Real-Git assertions cover path, branch, bindings, deps, absence of _build and control immutability.

scenarios.reason: Admission is performed before provider launch with collision and missing-deps refusal, isolated worktree and harness paths, frozen bindings, plain deps copy, and no copied controller state.

evidence.locator: Build launch contexts bind per-Build Claude/Codex homes, scopes and operation roots.
Offline launch-environment tests and the paid live fixture assert frozen credential bindings and transcript locations.
Retained live evidence records the hybrid route and accepted real sessions.

scenarios.reason: Each Build uses its own harness home while preserving control-resolved credential bindings; environment scrubbing, selector freezing, cross-harness Expert routing and live session behavior are covered.

evidence.locator: Build threads explicit control and Candidate roots through role launches, verification and evidence.
Third-cwd and Candidate receipt assertions verify process cwd, Git toplevel and control-side locator behavior.

scenarios.reason: Roles, reports, verification, selectors and citations use the Candidate root explicitly, while tracking and retained artifacts remain control-side; third-cwd behavior is tested.

evidence.locator: Controller verification runs Candidate targets through its own supervised runner with scrubbed boundary and Mix context.
Candidate tampering and failing-target tests assert Candidate-bound receipts and controller judgment.

scenarios.reason: The parent controller runs verification in the Candidate outside role process trees, binds receipts to the Candidate and ignores tampered Candidate hook copies for judging.

evidence.locator: Build retry and rework paths retain the same Candidate and session while creating fresh Reviewer sessions.
Lifecycle tests assert one Candidate/home across verification and Review rework; live evidence records the accepted real Build.
Paid live fixture evidence records the hybrid route's resumed Build and acceptance.

scenarios.reason: Verification retries, Developer resumes and fresh Reviews reuse the same Candidate and harness home, with outer-attempt accounting preserved.

evidence.locator: Fast-forward publication validates branch attachment, unmoved baseline, clean control and synchronized HEAD/tree before non-forced cleanup.
Publication tests assert commit provenance, control synchronization, Approved-copy removal, Candidate removal and harness-home retention.

scenarios.reason: Accepted output is committed in the Candidate, fast-forwarded only onto an unmoved clean admitted branch, then cleaned up without deleting harness evidence.

evidence.locator: Publication refusal retains accepted Candidate state and reports baseline/current commits and removal command.
Tests cover moved branch, dirty control and wrong branch while asserting unchanged control and retained Candidate.

scenarios.reason: Moved, dirty or differently attached control checkouts refuse publication without altering control, the Approved package or the accepted Candidate.

evidence.locator: Stop handling records retained disposition and names Candidate/worktree/branch/removal details.
Failure-retention tests cover verification, outer allowance, Jev, integrity, provider and malformed-review stops plus fresh subsequent Candidates.

scenarios.reason: Non-publication stops retain Candidate, branch and harness evidence, preserve control, and ensure later Builds create distinct resources.

evidence.locator: Guard capture and publication operate on Candidate while control-side edits are checked separately.
Shaping-during-build tests perform Draft/package/login writes in control and assert successful publication plus negative controls.

scenarios.reason: Concurrent Shaping writes to unrelated control-side ignored state do not enter Candidate verification or publication; own Approved mutation and tracked control edits remain guarded.

evidence.locator: Candidate listing/removal validates project ownership, live lock, path topology, worktree registration and accepted-commit reachability.
CLI tests cover multi-project isolation, stale/running records, foreign worktrees and discard rules.

scenarios.reason: List and remove commands are scoped to the current project and enforce running, ownership, registration and accepted-commit safeguards.

evidence.locator: Tracking and evidence code keeps record versions, packets and sidecars control-relative and verifies their digests.
Retention test removes the fixture/Candidate and verifies successful, altered and missing-sidecar resolution.

scenarios.reason: Retained records, packets and sidecars stay under control and remain resolvable after Candidate removal, with integrity failures preserved.

evidence.locator: WriteBoundary renders one canonical Build-wide Seatbelt profile and launch environment.
Boundary tests exercise role trees, helpers, grandchildren, aliases, protected paths and launch-service/Apple-event denials.
Paid evidence records the real hybrid route's accepted Reviewer run under the retained fixture.

scenarios.reason: All Build role launches use the kernel-enforced profile with grants limited to Candidate, harness, temp and required login state; tested process descendants and escape paths are denied.

evidence.locator: Admission validates sandbox executable, canonical grants, forbidden roots and kernel self-test before readiness.
Tests cover missing/failing sandbox, aliases, foreign confinement, nested inheritance and unconfined verification children.

scenarios.reason: Boundary activation failures and unsafe grants stop before role readiness with no unwrapped fallback; confinement mode is kernel-detected and controller verification is scrubbed.

evidence.locator: Codex launch contexts place operation roots under the Build harness and preserve required bypass flags and Candidate trust root.
Expert and Codex-scope boundary tests assert inherited Expert execution, denied Kogen-owned scope entries and unchanged state roots.
Paid hybrid evidence records the real Codex Reviewer route reaching acceptance.

scenarios.reason: Codex Reviewer and cross-harness Expert launches operate inside the Build boundary with scoped operation roots, denied protected entries and preserved native flags.
